description: Immediately logs an error trap diagnosed during a build failure or test error. Receives a conditional 2.0x recall boost for trap-intent or file-scoped queries.

assertion.description: Condition that keeps this memory relevant, checked against the working tree: text_present:<path>::<text>, symbol_present:<path>::<name>, or file_present:<path>. Once it stops holding, recall stops returning the memory.

content.description: Exact explanation of the error trap and the concrete workaround/fix

files.description: Code files affected by this error trap

title.description: Clear, imperative rule title (e.g. Never Use Date.now() for JWT Exp)

name: fastr_trap_log
